reviewer.identity: Codex independent adversarial checker; not the implementer
reviewer.tool: Codex desktop shell with zsh, Git 2.55.0, Cargo, OpenJDK 21.0.11, the pinned Java PlantUML JAR, and an exact 34cc76f1-built diff_one helper

diff_one.provenance_note: This helper was rebuilt from a git archive of implementation commit 34cc76f1, not from the later candidate 17888365 checkout. The exact class.rs blob hash matches the implementation commit under review.

java: CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity.executeInternal creates attached notes as real NOTE leaves in the current namespace and gives LEFT/RIGHT links length 1 and TOP/BOTTOM links length 2.

GraphvizImageBuilder.buildImage calls printGroups before getUnpackagedEntities; printGroup emits direct leaves before child groups, so package-first traversal rather than one global constructor order controls node creation.

Bibliotekon stores nodes in a LinkedHashMap and partitions length-one links into lines0; SvekResult.drawU paints allNodes in insertion order and leaves EntityImageNote to consume the solved edge path.

EntityImageNote.drawU reverses the solved path when necessary so the note-side contact is the start point, then getOpaleStrategy chooses the nearest note side by orthogonal distance with left, right, up, down tie priority.
rust: At 34cc76f1, crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs:2262-2274 registers LEFT/RIGHT attached notes as PlantUML line0 edges plus same-rank minlen-zero edges, mirroring Java length-one note links.

At 34cc76f1, crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs:2341-2368 routes note layout nodes through svek_node_emission_order and attaches them to the owner package cluster instead of emitting them in a later kind-specific batch.

At 34cc76f1, crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs:4276-4284 qualifies attached GMN names and floating aliases with the owner package path so reopened package notes resolve to the same namespace model as Java.
At 34cc76f1, crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs:12735-12749 and 13196-13240 choose the rendered note callout side from the solved contact geometry rather than from the declared note keyword alone.

findings.summary: An exact 34cc76f1-built helper still fails all four fresh valid perturbations, so parity rule 10 rejects the mechanism claim.
findings.evidence: I rebuilt diff_one from a git archive of 34cc76f1 with one Cargo invocation, verified the source class.rs blob hash as 89ed99f2179b5ce8f6cba38d01add4f011974463, and reran the four preserved followup2 cases. Every case still exits 1 under --no-oracle.

findings.summary: The dense attached-note flip probe remains a mechanism-shaped counterexample against solved-contact side selection and note rendering order.
findings.evidence: In followup2_lr_dense_attached_notes_flip_probe, the exact 34cc-built helper maps the note texts to the wrong geometry blocks: declared left lands on the bottom geometry, declared right lands on the top geometry, declared top lands on the left geometry, and declared bottom lands on the right geometry.

findings.summary: Reopened package ownership plus mixed attached/floating notes still breaks unified direct-leaf order.
findings.evidence: In followup2_tb_reopened_outer_mixed_attached_floating, Rust emits 79 elements versus Java 63 and reorders the note/class stream around Orbit9403, including swapping the expected FloatDirect9415 position for FloatDesc9413.

findings.summary: Reopened package descendants with multiple notes still misorder entities and note ownership in both rank directions.
findings.evidence: followup2_lr_reopened_outer_all_positions_direct_descendant and followup2_tb_reopened_outer_two_notes_same_target both produce broad but mechanism-shaped reorganizations of package contents, attached notes, and linked classes under reopened owners.

findings.summary: I still found no fixture-shaped logic, golden reads, output surgery, or unexplained high-precision constants in the 34cc76f1 production diff.
findings.evidence: The rejecting verdict comes from failing held-out perturbations, not from evidence of cheating.
